<b>Mossgrubs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are fur covered crawler [[Mossmirs]] that have a series of sharp spikes along their backs.<ref>Mossgrub [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Fur covered crawler with a series of sharp spikes along its back."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mossgrubs wander aimlessly or stay still on floors or walls, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. If provoked, they begin to crawl towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], or in the direction they were initially facing if they are on a wall.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Mossgrubs have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2
|
* Protect us, mother!
* Call for danger, hide away...
* Young must eat, grow or die...
* Sleep and change, have no fear...
}}

== Location ==
Mossgrubs are found primarily in the [[Moss Grotto]], but can also be seen in the western portion of [[Weavenest Atla]] and the Moss Grotto section of the [[Memorium]]. They can be summoned by [[Moss Mother]]s in the [[Ruined Chapel]] and the western portion of Weavenest Atla.
